title: Benzinga: The Next Industrial Revolution May Come From Biology
summary: Excerpt As biology shifts toward an engineering discipline, a Los Angeles biotech company, eXoZymes (Nasdaq: EXOZ), is betting that engineered enzyme systems can bridge the gap between digital molecule design and physical production.

As biology shifts toward an engineering discipline, a Los Angeles biotech company, eXoZymes (Nasdaq: EXOZ), is betting that engineered enzyme systems can bridge the gap between digital molecule design and physical production.
